# GitHub Copilot instructions
You are building Little Arcade v2 for a 3-year-old. Consult `AGENTS.md`, `v2/AGENTS.md`, the relevant `v2/docs/`, and `v2/games/` specs. Implement v2 incrementally; preserve the compatibility-spike and platform decisions in the v2 roadmap. Do not invent pinouts or ESP-SR APIs. Touchscreen input is always a complete alternative to voice. Use command intent enums, not raw recognition text, in game code. Tests and measured flash/PSRAM usage are required. Run containers with WSL containers (`wslc`), never Docker. When a game or feature is done and its build/tests pass, commit it to `main` and push `main` (see `AGENTS.md` rule 12). Avoid child-data collection, Wi-Fi, accounts, punishments, advertising, and copyrighted character likenesses.
